text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Scanned copy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form 6. Scanned copy of the original school report cards of all subjects with their notarial certificates; 7. Scanned copy of recommendation letter from the high school 8. Scanned copy of economic guarantee issued by the bank 9. Guarantee letter of the guardian for the student under 18 years old
